summary: VivoPower PLC filed Form 6-K announcing full retirement of US$28.8 million shareholder debt principal owed to AWN Holdings, affiliated with Executive Chairman Kevin Chin. Of this, US$16.5 million was retired via AWN's participation in a US$50 million PIPE 2, with AWN receiving 165,000 convertible preference shares and a 6-month lock-up; the remaining US$12.3 million was paid in cash. The Audit and Risk Committee of independent directors approved the related-party transaction. This strengthens the balance sheet ahead of a Nordic AI infrastructure buildout. Residual interest will be repaid later. Watch for completion of residual payments and subsequent capital deployment.
